mission: Ongoing original and copyright-respecting competitive research for Bizarre Past, What If in 40 Seconds and Little Wild Adventures. Grow views, engaged views, retention, subscribers and monetization eligibility through stronger content; never replicate third-party scripts/scenes/characters/music.
cadence: Weekly cross-channel research plus micro-research in each channel agent before preparing videos.
confidenceGuidelines: Use dated primary channel videos where possible; label third-party counts as dated estimates.
Compare views at similar video ages and by format; don't confuse correlation with causation.
Separate what we observed from what we propose to test. Never guarantee virality.
Use public watch pages and sources without unnecessary paid vidIQ calls; never buy credits automatically.
Use YT Analytics / Metricool for our channel performance, where available.
Made-for-kids videos often disable comments; do not interact with children's content to game engagement.

bizarre.name: History Matters
bizarre.observed: 2026-11-03: 16 October 2026 long film about Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact 9:07, 815,111 third-party views after 18 calendar days. Questions (WHY) dominate titles; exact opening and pace not watched.
bizarre.test: Test original sourced WHY-mysteries with immediate Did you know hook; start with a fact-checked Roman scroll digitally read without opening it; do not imply views are caused by title.
bizarre.confidence: High that packaging pattern exists; no direct causal proof for views.

wild.name: Numberblocks

wild.test: Use short original child-friendly counting/colour/song beats only where story and character continuity remain strong.

wild.name: Daniel Tiger's Neighborhood
wild.observed: Original preschool narratives use recognizable child-perspective characters, everyday social routines, catchy short musical strategies and personal participation. No private retention figures verified.

scope: Six dated video metadata case studies, including three Shorts verified by direct vertical cover or publisher list, one long history film, one long preschool episode and one ambiguous-duration speculative film.
All six thumbnails/covers directly visually inspected with the free vidIQ image tool; QuirkScience full transcript analyzed for dramatic script sequence and payoff, no playback claims.
One new independently-sourced original test concept per channel; internal Metricool comparisons with clear missing age-matched metrics.
lastResearch.accessNotes: All six thumbnails were directly inspected on 2026-11-03 via zero-credit vidIQ images. Public YouTube video playback and first 2s audio/video were not accessible; only QuirkScience full script text available and read. Third-party view snapshots as-of dates stated; age-matched 24h/7d/28d video analytics missing.
lastResearch.limitations: Third-party video counters are public snapshots, not owners' YouTube Studio analytics. AgeDays=calendar days at snapshot; not actual 24h/7d curves. Actual video/audio playback of six public competitor videos was unavailable (YouTube fetch throttled); first 2 seconds, soundtrack, shot pacing and exact motion were NOT inspected. Thumbnails/covers of all six were directly inspected with free vidIQ images. QuirkScience full publisher transcript WAS inspected for story order and ending. Inferred storytelling structures above are hypotheses based on public titles and publishers' self-descriptions, not firsthand observations. No apples-to-apples comparison between large established channels, small 2026 channels and new owned channels with different publishing age/length. Do not copy others' scripts, characters, copyrighted footage, music or thumbnail designs, and do not imitate unverifiable 'solved mystery' certainty. No video was created, scheduled, published, liked or commented on during this research run. The canonical 18:00 Oslo schedule remains untouched. No vidIQ paid credits were consumed in connector calls for this run.
lastResearch.littleWildInternalReview: Watched actual owned exported 1080x1920 MP4s with audio: Brush Along with Milo (34s), Cozy Bedtime Countdown (37s), Sharing Is More Fun (34s). Strongest approved production reference Brush; recent narration often describes rather than dramatizes, and refers to supporting cast as generic Bird/Meerkat.

recommendedTest.title: Did You Know a Volcano Hid a Library We Can Read Without Opening?
recommendedTest.first2Seconds: DID YOU KNOW… a volcano sealed a library for nearly 2,000 years?
recommendedTest.plot: Vis Vesuvius 79 e.Kr. og forkullet papyrus, så moderne virtuelt utbrettet tekst; presiser at ett konkret manuskript ble lest helt i juni 2026.
recommendedTest.payoff: Vi kan lese den første hele forkullede rullen uten å fysisk åpne den; et historisk mysterium med faktabasert løsning.
recommendedTest.measurement: engaged views, viewed/swiped and 24h/7d/28d video-age-equivalent retention; compare only with similar Shorts.

learnings.finding: Gode hypotetiske konsepter lar et konkret spørsmål utløse en umiddelbar visuell transformasjon og et forståelig naturvitenskapelig svar; publisher descriptions are not retention proof.

recommendedTest.title: What If You Could See Flowers Through a Bee's Eyes?
recommendedTest.format: 35–40s full-motion Short after currently scheduled content
recommendedTest.first2Seconds: WHAT IF… you could see a flower the way a bee does?
recommendedTest.plot: Normal flowers -> stylized false-color UV perspective with 'nectar guides' -> a bee goes straight to nectar; state visual is an illustrative false-color mapping.
recommendedTest.payoff: Mange blomster viser UV-mønstre som mennesker ikke ser og som hjelper pollinatorer å orientere seg.
recommendedTest.measurement: hook in first 2 sec, engaged views, viewed vs swiped, average watch duration and subs per 1000 matched-age views.

learnings.finding: Preskole-eksempler pakket rundt små gjenkjennelige problemer eller ett uttalt læringsmål. Det fremstår overførbart til serien; konkrete videoer er ikke faktisk avspilt.

recommendedTest.title: Milo and the Shadow That Wouldn't Stay Still!
recommendedTest.format: 35–40s full-motion Short, then possible 8–10 min Sunday story only if enough plot
recommendedTest.first2Seconds: Milo og blå fugl lager en skyggetegning. Skyggen flytter seg – hvordan kan det skje?
recommendedTest.plot: Milo, brun surikat, og den samme lille blå fuglen prøver med et leketøy, sol og lommelykt; skyggen forandrer størrelse og sted når lyset flytter seg. Ha aktiv dialog og konsekvente figurer.
recommendedTest.payoff: Barn forstår at skygger lages når noe stopper lyset, og at de forandrer seg når lys eller gjenstand flyttes.
recommendedTest.measurement: enhetlig visuell identitet og full-motion QC, gjennomsnittlig seertid/retensjon når YouTube-analyse er tilgjengelig.
